claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Live CLI validation: this run's runner reports `claude --version` as `2.1.274 (Claude Code)`, matching the target exactly. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance from 2.1.273 to **2.1.274** together (no divergence). Reviewed the full published 2.1.274 changelog entry line by line for catalog surface: Git LFS files in plugin/marketplace clones now stay pointers instead of downloading (this catalog carries no LFS-tracked assets — checked via `git lfs ls-files` and the absence of any `.gitattributes` — so nothing changes here); a fix for a plugin loaded from a `.zip` being served from a stale extraction after overlapping reloads (this catalog's `source` is `github` exclusively for all three plugins — `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` never uses the `.zip`/archive source type — so the affected code path is never exercised); a fix for plugins with a top-level `$schema` key in `hooks/hooks.json` wrongly showing an 'unknown key' notice (checked directly — this repo ships no `hooks.json` anywhere, confirmed via `search_code` and a repo-wide `find`; the `run-plugins-catalog` skill's frontmatter has an empty `hooks: {}` map, which is unrelated); and the new `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` environment variable for tuning MCP server startup timeouts (this catalog defines no MCP servers of its own — the 'MCP server stubs' mentioned in the README belong to the `tamirs-superpowers` plugin's own repo, out of scope here). None of 2.1.274's four changelog entries touch marketplace-manifest, plugin-source, or skill-loading behavior in a way this catalog can act on. `claude plugin validate --strict --json .agents/skills` (piped through `scripts/report-skill-validation.py`) and a full `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests, `make agent:check`, 3 plugins in sync, no drift) both passed clean against the live 2.1.274 CLI. Nothing to adopt beyond the version bump — the prior 2.1.271 review (`--accept-command <sha256>`, documented) and 2.1.269 (`claude plugin eval`, reviewed and found not applicable — this catalog ships no plugin source to eval) remain the most recent substantive and itemized deltas; full per-version history remains in the install guide's per-version sections.

cursor.supported_min_source: Cursor documents no minimum version for plugins; the floor is the version actually validated rather than guessed. The previous 0.45.0 floor predates Cursor's plugin system entirely
cursor.verification_method: latest desktop build from official Cursor download links (3.18.9, 2026-08-30 stable) cross-checked against cursor.com/changelog (feature 3.11; date-only entries through 2026-09-02 Self-Hosted Machines / Team Pools / partner sandboxes / computer use); team-marketplace import is a Dashboard flow

codex.supported_min_source: earliest release this catalog has claimed .agents/plugins/marketplace.json support for
codex.verification_method: documentary revalidation by this repo's standing Codex method (official release notes plus catalog compatibility review; the Codex CLI is not installed on the review machine). Reviewed every openai/codex release from 0.148.0 through 0.153.4 for plugin/marketplace changes: #41208 (0.151.0) reports invalid project marketplaces without hiding valid plugins, #41953 (0.153.0) enforces a marketplace source policy for OpenAI-curated plugins only, and #42149/#42150 (0.153.0) upgrade Git marketplaces from merged configuration and add remote-marketplace support to the plugin CLI. None alter the portable Agent Plugin catalog shape, so .agents/plugins/marketplace.json remains discoverable unchanged; 0.153.0 widens how it can be consumed rather than narrowing it.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: `opencode --version` on the maintainer machine (reported 1.18.29); latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — skill discovery is verified directly with `opencode debug skill`, pointing `skills.paths` at this repo's `.agents/skills` and confirming `run-plugins-catalog` resolves to its `SKILL.md`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
